environment.description: Rails 7.1 application deployed on a bare-metal Ubuntu 22.04 server running Puma 6.x directly. The application is exposed via nginx reverse proxy with keepalive connections enabled. No additional network controls. The server has low background noise (dedicated instance), making timing measurements highly reliable. Rate limit is set to 1000 requests/minute which allows sufficient statistical sampling for timing analysis.

config.proxy: nginx 1.24 with keepalive, no additional middleware
config.network: Direct internet exposure, <1ms jitter on same datacenter
